# Ingestion, Scoping & Source Inspector Checklist: Text/PDF Ingestion & Inspector

**Purpose**: Reviewer-owned requirements-quality validation ("Unit Tests for English") covering PDF/TXT/MD/Copied-Text ingestion and `UnifiedDocumentChunk` normalization (`FR-SI-01`, `C-01`), granular source selection (`FR-SI-03`, `C-02`, `NFR-EVAL-04`), and deterministic Source Inspector navigation (`FR-SI-04`, `Gate v1.0`).
**Created**: 2026-10-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all four v1.0 input modalities (`.pdf` including scanned OCR pages and tables, `.txt`, `.md`, and `Copied text`) specified with their state transitions (`Uploading` $\rightarrow$ `Processing` $\rightarrow$ `Ready` or `Failed`)? [Completeness, Spec §R01 — FR-SI-01 (Subset A)]
- [x] CHK002 Does the specification define the complete five-field `UnifiedDocumentChunk` (`Contract C-01`) schema (`source_id`, `chunk_id`, `text`, `token_count`, `locator`) and require 100% schema conformance (`Gate v1.0 #1`)? [Completeness, Spec §R01 — FR-SI-01 (Subset A), Spec §Success Criteria SC-001]
- [x] CHK003 Are the UI and server requirements for granular source selection ($S_{\text{aktiv}}$) complete across individual source checkboxes, the `"Select all sources"` master checkbox, the `"<n> sources"` badge in the chat input bar, and the zero-selected-sources state? [Completeness, Spec §R02 — FR-SI-03]
- [x] CHK004 Are all three Source Inspector entry/exit interactions specified: opening at the top via source title click, opening and scrolling/highlighting via inline citation badge `[n]` click, and closing (`✕`) back to the source list while preserving chat state? [Completeness, Spec §R03 — FR-SI-04]

## Requirement Clarity & Precision

- [x] CHK005 Is the `Contract C-01` `locator` representation unambiguously specified for both PDFs (`page_span` with physical `page` and paragraph/character offsets) and text-only sources (`page_span` with optional physical `page` omitted and paragraph/character offsets)? [Clarity, Spec §R01 — FR-SI-01 (Subset A), Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK006 Is the default title `"Pasted text"` and minimum non-whitespace length ($1$ Unicode code point after outer trim, up to $500,000$ extracted words) clearly specified for the `Copied text` sub-dialog? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §R01 — FR-SI-01 (Subset A)]
- [x] CHK007 Does the specification clearly distinguish between viewing an unchecked source in the Source Inspector (an authorized singleton `C-02` read) and modifying the active chat selection ($S_{\text{aktiv}}$)? [Clarity, Spec §Cross-package acceptance scenarios #5, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK008 Are the error messages and failure states for empty files (`"File is empty"`), password-protected/corrupted PDFs (`"Could not read file (password-protected or corrupted)"`), and zero-text vector PDFs (`"No extractable text found"`) explicitly defined? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §Edge Cases FR-SI-01]

## Requirement Consistency & Contract Alignment

- [x] CHK009 Do `spec.md`, `plan.md`, and `contracts/interfaces.md` consistently enforce that newly Ready sources become auto-selected only in the importing user's browser session and never act as an implicit server-side fallback when `active_source_ids` is omitted or empty? [Consistency, Spec §R02 — FR-SI-03, Spec §Cross-package requirements CP-01]
- [x] CHK010 Is the deferral of `Source Guide` summary/topic headers to `v2.0` (`FR-SI-02`) and multimodal/Drive/URL sources to `v3.0` (`FR-SI-01` Subset B) consistent across `spec.md` and `plan.md`? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions & Out of Scope, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK011 Are chunk sizing and overlap parameters (`300–600` tokens target without crossing page/section boundaries) consistently treated as chunker policy rather than extra `Contract C-01` schema fields? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases FR-SI-04, Spec §Assumptions & Out of Scope]

## Acceptance Criteria & Measurability

- [x] CHK012 Are the performance and gate thresholds objectively measurable: standard $20$-page digital PDF `Ready` in $\le 5.0\text{ s}$ (P95), active source counter update in $\le 50\text{ ms}$, and citation click-to-scroll in $\le 300\text{ ms}$ with 100% deterministic `[data-chunk-id]` targeting (`Gate v1.0 #3`)? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-001/SC-002/SC-003]
- [x] CHK013 Is the zero-leakage requirement for deselected sources ($s_i \notin S_{\text{aktiv}} \implies \text{Leakage} = 0$ on `NFR-EVAL-04`, `Gate v1.0 #2`) stated as an exact deterministic invariant? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria SC-002]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK014 Is the behavior specified when a user toggles source selection checkboxes while a previous chat response is actively streaming (preserving the submission-time `(source_id, revision)` snapshot for the in-flight turn)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases FR-SI-03, Spec §Clarifications]
- [x] CHK015 Is the behavior specified when a user clicks a second citation `[3]` from a different source while the Source Inspector is already open on citation `[1]`? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases FR-SI-04]
- [x] CHK016 Are large-document rendering requirements ($400,000$-word source in the Source Inspector via virtualized/windowed chunk rendering) and concurrent batch upload responsiveness ($20$ simultaneous PDFs) specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Boundary acceptance, Spec §Edge Cases FR-SI-01/FR-SI-04]
- [x] CHK017 Does the specification address how deleting a currently checked source updates $S_{\text{aktiv}}$, decrements the `"<n> sources"` badge, and invalidates in-flight or historical access? [Edge Case, Spec §Boundary acceptance, Spec §Edge Cases FR-SI-03]

## Notes
